title: Koenigsegg Gemera vs Regera: The Real Difference
description:
Two Koenigsegg hybrids, one very different idea. The Regera has no gearbox in the usual sense, and sold out in two years. The Gemera has four seats, and took six years to reach production. They look like cousins, but the numbers say they were built for different jobs. We compare them side by side, and every figure comes from a named source. Our sources are Wikipedia's pages on the Gemera, the Regera and Koenigsegg, a March twenty twenty-six report on AOL, Motor1, InsideHook and the RM Sotheby's catalogue for a twenty twenty Regera. Where they disagree, we show both figures. Our own maths is labelled as our arithmetic. Anything we could not find is flagged.

Every figure in this video comes from a published source, listed below.
